sub_indicators.label: Digital policy research
sub_indicators.subject: capacity.research
sub_indicators.text: Think tanks and academic departments contributing to DT policy: digital policy research
sub_indicators.norm_short: STISA-2034 and Agenda 2063's second ten-year plan ask for research systems funded toward 1 per cent of GDP and contributing to policy; neither counts think tanks.
criteria: A source from the past three years says no local institution researches digital policy.
A local institution has held a research workshop, opened a chair, centre or project on digital policy, or joined a research network on it.
A local think tank, university centre or department has published research on digital policy, such as a report, study or index.
A local institution submitted evidence to a consultation, was commissioned by government for a study, or sits on an advisory body, on a digital policy, law or strategy.
A local research institution holds a standing advisory role in digital policy, or a national research agenda on digital transformation is adopted.
